prior_pending_row.question: On Passage
prior_pending_row.reason: The complete H.R. 10326 EH and own full floor reproduction are read and match under declared formatting normalization, with H.Res. 1530 section 2 identity. Written Attorney General requests require States to provide records for investigating/prosecuting alleged fraud in 12 listed program categories plus other federally funded State programs identified as vulnerable. The scope includes identity, disbursement, provider billing, active-fraud-related demographics and other information determined appropriate for that fraud purpose. Section 3 retains Privacy Act compliance, HIPAA regulations where applicable, encryption/authorized-access/destruction requirements and fraud-only federal use with unrelated administrative/commercial disclosure prohibited; no unrestricted immigration-enforcement use is inferred. The full 2024 Privacy Act operative body retains(a)(2) citizen/LPR individual definition, distinct disclosure exceptions, access/redress, qualified criminal/general/specific exemptions and matching safeguards. Its complete quoted Judicial Redress Act note separately provides qualified remedies for covered persons/records/countries/designated agencies and preserves limitations/privileges; no all-other-person absolute remedy exclusion or current designation is asserted. The bill separate security/use limits remain distinct from individual Privacy Act remedies. Program beneficiary/provider status or HIPAA integration and bounded Immigration application remain material research; no automatic universal privacy coverage or immigrant benefit-status change is inferred from the program list. Keep unresolved/noncounting, no new meaning, component stance or hold release. Existing Health candidate core/ref/digests remain unchanged as comparator, not approved Immigration meaning. Own passage question precedes voice ayes, Raskin demand/order and postponement, followed later by 217-207 with 9 Not Voting, Foushee Nay and Massie Nay. No actual fraud/guilt, enforcement result, benefit eligibility, enacted/current implementation or motive is inferred.
